officialPrimaryLocators.section: C10 Lernbereich 2, Kompetenzerwartungen bullet 9 and Inhalte solution preparation; C10 Lernbereich 1 Inhalte measure-solution preparation
officialPrimaryLocators.observationParaphrase: The curriculum connects concentration calculations with preparing defined acid/base solutions. Its laboratory techniques section also names preparing standard solutions. A supplied-instruction preparation component is a defensible partial operationalization; independent calculation, planning and full acid/base competence remain separate.

officialPrimaryLocators.section: C10 Lernbereich 4, Kompetenzerwartungen bullet 8 and corresponding Inhalte
officialPrimaryLocators.observationParaphrase: The same declared-concentration solution-preparation context supports a bounded practical component. It does not equate instruction-following with the complete curricular calculation and experiment duties.
